title: Busan in 3 days: beaches, cafes and culture in 10 stops
desc: A three-day Busan route from arrival to departure, covering Haeundae, Gamcheon, Jeonpo, Samgwangsa and Gwangalli in visiting order.

items.title: Busan Station (부산역)
items.memo: KTX terminal and main arrival point from Seoul.

items.title: Haeundae Beach (해운대해수욕장)
items.memo: Busan's best-known beach, with plenty of hotels nearby.

items.title: Haeundae Traditional Market (해운대전통시장)
items.memo: Traditional market near the beach for street food.

items.title: Haeundae Blueline Park, Mipo Station (해운대블루라인파크 미포정거장)
items.memo: Station for the Sky Capsule coastal rail ride.

items.title: Gamcheon Culture Village (감천문화마을)
items.memo: Colorful hillside village of painted houses and alleys.

items.title: Samgwangsa Temple (삼광사)
items.memo: Temple known for its yearly Lotus Lantern Festival with 40,000+ lanterns.

items.title: Gwangalli Beach (광안리해수욕장)
items.memo: Beach facing Gwangan Bridge; worth seeing by day and lit up at night.
